resources.string: Separate notifications with commas. Use a negative number for after the event. Incomplete entries stay in your draft.
Discard these saved fields from this device? No event will be changed or selected automatically.
First stop the original save from being sent, then discard this draft. If the save may already have been sent, or an event was saved, this draft will be kept so you can check its result.
Stop any pending original save before starting a separate draft. The new draft needs another explicit Save. Choose a calendar again for a new event; an edit stays with its original calendar.
The original save is kept unchanged. Check its result before making another save.
Check the event details before saving.
This time happens twice. Choose the first or second occurrence below.
This time does not exist on that date. Choose another time.
Allow calendar access, then tap Save again.
This event cannot be changed here.
This draft cannot be verified against the current event. Review the latest event before applying it.
We could not confirm whether this was saved. Check the save result before trying again.
Calendar is unavailable. Your draft is kept.
Your draft could not be saved on this device. Keep this screen open and try again.
The original save has been stopped. It will not be sent again.
The original save was not sent. You can retry that same save.
The original save cannot be retried safely here. Check its result.
Continue this saved draft before changing its fields.
This saved draft needs a newer version of Daylight.
Discard could not be confirmed. Your original draft is kept. Check its result before trying again.
The original save may already have been sent. Check its result; keep the draft until its outcome is known.
This event was saved on this device. Discarding a draft cannot undo that save or create another event.
The original save could not be identified safely. Your draft is kept for review.
This older save cannot be discarded safely here. Your draft is kept.
Saving updates this device. Your calendar account handles sync.
The original calendar cannot be verified. You can check the save result, but this save cannot be retried here.
The original visibility cannot be confirmed. Check the save result before creating a separate copy.
Choose a calendar before saving this draft.
This event was saved on this device. Finish closing its draft; it will not be saved again.
This event was deleted on this device. Finish closing its draft; it will not be deleted again.
Choose a supported region time zone, such as Europe/London, before saving this time. Your calendar cannot safely use the current zone.
